title: Serve the Data Parade articles under /posts
description: In DataParade-newsroom: set urls.basePath to /posts in web/projection.json once PPY-f8da7a ships, move the site's own links (nav, chrome stylesheet) under /posts, redirect / to /posts/ on dataparade.anth.us, turn on publicData, bump the Papyrus pins, deploy, and verify every page, feed, sitemap and _data file under /posts on dataparade.anth.us. productionUrl moves to https://dataparade.io only when the dataparade.io mount exists.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/PPY-be0f8d-posts-base-path in DataParade-newsroom (61b1a8c): basePath /posts, / -> /posts/ redirect, publicData, hooks.py with the landing navbar/footer/theme switch/post cards, site-theme.css on the landing tokens, newsroom theme on the app neutrals. Waiting on the Papyrus release with urls.basePath (PR 489) to bump the pins and deploy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed: DataParade-newsroom PR #2 (feature) and #3 (develop->main, d3187ad2), Papyrus pins 5.16.0, Amplify job 5 SUCCEED. Verified live: / 301 -> /posts/; /posts/, feed.xml, sitemap.xml, _data/latest.json ([] until the first article), llms.txt, css and assets 200 under /posts/; robots.txt names /posts/sitemap.xml; /newsroom 200. Removed the stale root objects of the old layout from the versioned site bucket (index, feeds, sitemap, llms.txt, css/, assets/, _plugins/); /feed.xml now 404. productionUrl stays https://dataparade.anth.us until the dataparade.io mount (PPY-b63c46).
